Sar.reason: SAR is used as a method acronym (e.g., Semantic Entropy SAR, SAR EigenScore) rather than referring to the Sar human language

English.reason: English appears in language pair names (German–English, French–English) for translation datasets, indicating the human language but only as part of evaluation data

French.reason: French appears in the language pair French–English for translation datasets, referring to the human language but only mentioned for evaluation purposes

German.reason: German appears in the language pair German–English for translation datasets, referring to the human language but only mentioned for evaluation purposes
